mapper.select: SELECT user_id, username, email, password, full_name, phone, address, created_at, created_by, updated_at, updated_by, u.is_active, u.is_deleted, avatar_url, r.role_id, r.role_name, r.role_code FROM public."user" u LEFT JOIN public."role" r ON u.role = r.role_id WHERE u.username = #{username} FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY

SELECT user_id, username, email, password, full_name, phone, address, created_at, created_by, updated_at, updated_by, u.is_active, u.is_deleted, avatar_url, r.role_id, r.role_name, r.role_code FROM public."user" u LEFT JOIN public."role" r ON u.role = r.role_id WHERE u.email = #{email} FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM public."user" WHERE username = #{username} AND is_deleted = 0
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM public."user" u WHERE u.email = #{email} AND u.is_deleted = 0
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public."user" WHERE user_id = #{id})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public."user" ( username, email, password, address, created_at, created_by, updated_at, updated_by, is_active, is_deleted, avatar_url, "role" ) VALUES ( #{username}, #{email}, #{password}, #{address}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{createdBy}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{updatedBy}, #{isActive}, 0, #{avatarUrl}, #{role.roleId} ) RETURNING user_id
mapper.update: UPDATE public."user" SET full_name = #{user.fullName}, email = #{user.email}, phone = #{user.phone}, address = #{user.address}, avatar_url = #{user.avatarUrl}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = #{user.updatedBy} WHERE user_id = #{userId}
